author: Polar_Express
body:
Hi folks!

Here is my latest Walls map. 

It has a large open cavern to start your hunt for diamonds etc. The map includes the "Crusader's" set of items and a large tower to explore / hide in. You can shoot the other team's tower from your tower if you want to do that. You can also jump from the 44 block High tower down into a waterfall...  Easy travel around your quad as all paths connect, along with  with two open mine entrances.  Once walls fall, middle uses the area of the other quads to provide a unique center game-play. Chests in middle are on top of small towers that have ladders. Not sure if that can be seen from the shots.

Anyway, Thanks for looking!

Screen Shots: http://imgur.com/a/W7DW4
Screen Shot with Shader On: http://imgur.com/MTAQEpK
Map with YML : https://www.dropbox.com/s/jxd5pqocav9fd9x/knightstower.zip?dl=0
